scope: All CSV members of IP-files.zip and Z-wave-files.zip; JSON and PCAP records were not analysed
aggregation: IP flows, Z-Wave flows and Z-Wave packets are reported separately. Their rows are not unique events and must not be added as a count of unique exchanges.
limitations: Every released Z-Wave flow row has label Benign. This does not establish that the wider dataset contains no attacks.
The Z-Wave packet CSVs have no attack label column. Their benign/attack counts and ratio cannot be established from these CSVs.
Missing cells are counted using the documented tokens. Structural absence is not automatically an erroneous reading.
